## Deviations (recorded as they happened)
- Gram GEMMs use TF32 inputs (fp32 storage and accumulation), the only TF32 use; pre-registered as fp32. Reason: fp32 Grams made calibration ~42 min/arm (fc2's 4,608² Gram dominated); with TF32, 28 min/arm.
- H̃_⊥ is formed in fp64 and symmetrized; GPTQ's Cholesky retries with damping ×10 when M_Q is not numerically PD (the damping actually used is logged per layer as `gptq_damp_used`). fp32 cancellation broke PD-ness on PixArt's outlier channels (block 0, attn2.to_q).
- deepcompressor needed Python 3.11 features (`typing.Self`, `enum.StrEnum`); it runs in an isolated venv on 3.10 with a two-line backport (`sitecustomize.py`) and without xformers / ImageReward / lm_eval extras. Its SVDQuant uses its own protocol (128 calibration prompts, fp16, activation shift + unsigned activations, weight range search); its GPU time is logged by hand from its run log.
